properties.name: A requirement or decision is sent to another design by move, piece or derived, received there at proposed, and binds on the receiver's word
properties.rationale: Anthony's rulings: binding once accepted and write-only-at-proposed (2026-10-07); move-or-decompose, never copy (2026-10-07); the DECOMPOSES widening and the move semantics (2026-10-08). Two new tools rather than new fields on add_requirement: the two halves are different acts in different designs, and each one's refusal (approver, still satisfied, already ruled on) belongs to its own act.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Item 5 of the one-graph build order (slice 3 of the hub work). New tools send_to_design and receive_from_design. Nothing is copied: a requirement wholly a part's moves, the parent keeping a reference that OBSOLETES it; one that spans parts stays, with each part's piece DECOMPOSES-linked; a decision stays, and its consequences arrive as derived requirements GOVERNED_BY it. DECOMPOSES is widened to reach a reference. upstream_status and loop_status report what waits on the receiver's owner.
